# [STORY] As an analyst, I want movie-view events published to Kafka and consumed into a most-requested endpoint, so that popularity data drives product decisions

## User Story
**As an** analyst
**I want** movie-view events published to Kafka and consumed into a most-requested endpoint
**So that** popularity data drives product decisions

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a movie is viewed, when the facade saves-through, then an event is published to Kafka
- [x] Given the analytics consumer runs, when events accumulate, then a most-requested endpoint reflects real usage
